meta.title: Spring Boneアニメーション処理の最適化: 行列演算のキャッシュ
meta.body_summary: Optimize Spring Bone animation processing by caching matrix inverse and other repeated computations, achieving 5.1% overall execution time reduction with benchmark data.

perf_labels.notes: Devin provided benchmark data showing 5.1% improvement; PR closed by maintainer without review, likely due to bot archival or inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 72 changed lines in a single file, this is a small, focused optimization. Despite providing benchmark evidence, the PR was closed without review, indicating process issues rather than technical rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or feedback was given; the PR was closed by the maintainer with no comment. Only bot activity (Devin assistant and archival notice) occurred.
review_details.performance_claim: 5.1% overall execution time improvement, 12.5% in targeted function, 24.8% reduction in inverted_safe calls.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_computation (matrix inversions were computed multiple times unnecessarily)
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed the PR without review; Devin bot indicated archival. No comments or change requests.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small-scope optimization with benchmark evidence, but closed without review likely due to bot archival/inactivity policy. This highlights a process boundary where agent PRs may not receive maintainer attention even with strong evidence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes before/after profiling statistics with function call counts and times, enabling independent validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without any regression analysis; likely due to bot archival rather than performance regression.

core_change_summary.description: In handler.py, matrix inversions and repeated computations in calculate_joint_pair_head_pose_bone_rotations are cached to avoid redundant calculations, reducing total calls to inverted_safe by 24.8% and improving overall execution time by 5.1%.
change_trajectory: Single commit: implemented caching optimizations and added benchmark evidence in PR body.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot introduced itself and offered automatic comment/CI assistance.
Devin is archived and cannot be woken up; PR closed.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with optimization and benchmark data.
No human review or comment; bot left introductory message.
Maintainer closed PR ~23 hours later; bot noted archival.
